messages:
incident-bot: Pager: billing-metering anomaly detected — token_count drift >12% vs baseline in last 15m for production-us-west-2. Auto-create incident. Severity: P2. Links: https://ops.example.com/inc/1728182828 :rotating_light:
oncall-amber: taking pager. I’m running preflight checks now. tagging @sre-jamal and @billing-pm.
sre-jamal: ack — starting quick triage. can someone post the last successful emitter snapshot?
oncall-amber: snapshot pulled (small). attaching quick tail from emitter log: ```2026-02-18T22:07:52Z emitter[tx]: emitted_tokens=1254013
2026-02-18T22:08:52Z emitter[tx]: emitted_tokens=1523890 (jump)
2026-02-18T22:09:52Z billing-agg: count=1523890
```
billing-pm: confirmed customers started receiving overage flags ~22:09 UTC, initial support tickets inbound. Not widespread — looks concentrated on accounts routed through emitter pool epk-west-2-b.
seqa-ops: i'm kicking off the live recon job to reconcile emitted vs ingested, running idempotent backfill on the small window. run: `./tools/recon --start 2026-02-18T22:05 --end 2026-02-18T22:15 --mode=fast`
sre-jamal: good. hypothesis: emitter client retries doubled token payloads after transient 504s. check proxy logs for repeated POSTs from same client ids.
oncall-amber: grep shows repeated 429/504 upstream at 22:08 for a subset of clients. sample: `client_id=cli-9f3 status=504 attempts=3 payload_tokens=1024`
billing-pm: customer impact: small set (approx 120 accounts) flagged for overage. CS queue has 7 tickets so far, crediting in progress once we have recon output. tagging @cs-lee
cs-lee: saw tickets. triage notes: emailing affected customers with temporary mitigation note. please confirm scope and ETA for correct counts.
seqa-ops: recon job started, ETA ~8m. if recon finds duplicate emits we can run the dedupe backfill and push corrected tallies.
incident-bot: Changed status to: investigating -> mitigation in progress.
sre-jamal: mitigation step 1: enable emitter de-dup window (config: dedupe_window_ms=60000) on epk-west-2-b pool. I’m rolling a hotfix now (canary 5% -> 50% -> 100%).
oncall-amber: 5% canary applied. monitoring for dropped legitimate traffic.
seqa-ops: recon: preliminary shows ~11% of tokens in window are duplicates (matching client_id + request_hash).
billing-pm: okay roll canary to 50% and alert CS to pause auto-billing until we confirm backfill.
sre-jamal: canary at 50% -> no increase in errors. proceeding to 100%.
oncall-amber: 100% rolled. dedupe enabled across pool.
seqa-ops: dedupe backfill job queued. estimated job run ~22m for full backfill; we have fast-path for affected ledger range (~3m). starting fast-path now.
cs-lee: holding autobilling pause. drafting customer-safe credit plan; will post template here once ready.
billing-pm: good. after backfill we should reconcile and emit corrected usage rows, then run notify+credit pipeline. please do not re-enable autobilling until i confirm.
seqa-ops: fast-path complete. corrected delta applied for 118 accounts. diff summary: "applied_correction_tokens": "+/- 0 to -45k per account depending". artifacts: https://recon.example.com/jobs/1728182828/report
sre-jamal: verifying system counters now. dashboard shows token_count drift back within 0.5% of baseline post-backfill.
oncall-amber: monitoring 10m post-fix — no repeat spikes.
incident-bot: Incident status changed to: mitigation complete -> monitoring. Incident owners: oncall-amber, sre-jamal.
billing-pm: thanks team. CS: send final note and credits tonight. ops: please follow up with RCA and a post-incident runbook action to harden emitter retry logic.
cs-lee: will send customer email template in #customer-notifications after midnight PT.
sre-jamal: short RCA note: root-cause appears to be a transient upstream HTTP 504 causing client-side retry loop with missing idempotency keys; emitter accepted duplicate payloads. Mitigations: enable server-side dedupe window, require idempotency header for retry clients, add rate-limited retry policy to clients.
oncall-amber: creating postmortem ticket: https://pm.example.com/issue/BI-4821 action items: add stricter client-side retry backoff, add observability on repeated request_hash, and expand test harness.
billing-pm: closing customer-impact loop after credits issued. moving incident to resolved in 24h if no regressions. :white_check_mark:
